revoke role from user remove role

transcript.text: Let me search for the relevant SailPoint ISC API tools for role assignment.
The Access Request API is the right mechanism. Let me get the full details on that operation and also search for revoke/cancel.

Both grant and revoke use the **same single endpoint** — `POST /v3/access-requests` — differentiated by the `requestType` field.

---

## Grant a Role

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/access-requests
Authorization: Bearer {token}
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "requestType": "GRANT_ACCESS",
  "requestedFor": ["2c91808568c529c60168cca6f90c1313"],
  "requestedItems": [
    {
      "type": "ROLE",
      "id": "2c9180835d2e5168015d32f890ca1581",
      "comment": "Granting role programmatically"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Revoke a Role

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/access-requests
Authorization: Bearer {token}
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "requestType": "REVOKE_ACCESS",
  "requestedFor": ["2c91808568c529c60168cca6f90c1313"],
  "requestedItems": [
    {
      "type": "ROLE",
      "id": "2c9180835d2e5168015d32f890ca1581",
      "comment": "Revoking role programmatically"
    }
  ]
}
```

---

## Key Fields

| Field | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `requestType` | No (defaults to `GRANT_ACCESS`) | `"GRANT_ACCESS"` or `"REVOKE_ACCESS"` |
| `requestedFor` | **Yes** | Array of identity IDs (strings) to act on |
| `requestedItems[].type` | **Yes** | `"ROLE"` for roles; also supports `"ACCESS_PROFILE"`, `"ENTITLEMENT"` |
| `requestedItems[].id` | **Yes** | The role's ID |
| `requestedItems[].comment` | No | Justification comment |
| `clientMetadata` | No | Key-value map for custom attributes passed through the request |

## Auth

Get a token first via the client-credentials grant:

```http
POST https://{tenant}.identitynow.com/oauth/token
  ?grant_type=client_credentials
  &client_id={clientId}
  &client_secret={clientSecret}
```

Required scope for submitting access requests: `idn:access-request:manage` (or `idn:access-request-self:manage` for self-service only).

## Important Behavior Notes

- **Revocation goes through approval** just like a grant — if the role's revocation requires approval, it won't be instant.
- `requestedFor` accepts multiple identity IDs, so you can batch-grant/revoke in one call.
- The response is `202 Accepted` — it queues the request; poll `/v3/access-request-status` to track completion.

---

```answer-summary
endpoints:
  - method: POST
    path: /v3/access-requests
    api_version: v3
auth_flow: OAuth2 bearer token
required_scopes: [idn:access-request:manage]
key_parameters: [requestType, requestedFor, requestedItems, type, id]
```
